product_metadata.title: IMUSA USA GAU-80311 Electric Single Burner 1000-Watts, Stainless Steel, Silver
features: Stainless Steel Housing and Drip Tray
description: Whether you use the IMUSA Stainless Steel Electric Single Burner in your home, dorm, or office, it is the perfect cooking tool for heating your culinary creations quickly and effectively. It lets you keep your fondue hot, cook when away from home, or even make coffee at work! The 1,000 Watt Self-Cleaning Element and the Stainless Steel Drip Tray allow you to concentrate on your delicious concoction and forget about any messy cleanup. Featuring an easy to use thermostatic control and simple to read power indicator light, the IMUSA Stainless Steel Electric Single Burner is like a compact, convenient, and portable kitchen.
